Guest denied; no upload/search controls.
Normal account and editor without document membership denied without user search/upload.
Document member at AAL1 receives MFA CTA; upload unavailable.
Twenty-document archive opens a dedicated focused detail at 320/390/1440; metadata rename preserves active and grants, cancel protects unsaved edits, search/status filters reach server.
Invalid PDF rejected before preparation; valid PDF upload has no automatic grants. Object/array RPC normalization exercised.
Minimum search length, explicit selection/save for two accounts and persistence of a subsequent single-recipient change.

Revoking all grants requires an inline confirmation, cancelling preserves grants; confirmed revocation denies the next download and refresh removes the file.
Archive removes existing grants; reactivation does not restore them.

dependencies.scope_note: Residual advisories are in configuration/build tooling; production delivery is a static export without node_modules or a Node server. This is not a zero-vulnerability certification.

limits: All browser scenarios ran on this exact final package; services and users were simulated.
No real emails were sent and no live patient files or accounts were modified.
Native phone menus and real mailbox delivery still require the post-publication check described in the guide.
The assistant has not published a Cloudflare deployment or verified the live production configuration.
Clinical content and legal details require the existing professional review; this software release does not invent approvals.
